fields: Yep! Now bend over so I can get this harness around you…
OK! I’m gonna put this ball gag on ya now, are ya ready?
Oh, do you want blinders on?
No, not this time. I’d like to see!
How’s the view back there Rascal?
Lookin’ great! Let me know when she’s ready!
Aww look how cute she is with that ballgag on.
Oop, you’re drooling a bit, lemme get that for ya!
I’m gonna start warming her up back here, is that ok!
Haha, that’s my girl! She’s my absolute favorite to play with for that very reason!
Ok, I’m gonna go for it.
How are ya doin’ back there?
Haven’t done this with a bird before!
Oooh, she’s close, I can tell.
Gosh Rascal, you were really gettin’ in there!
Can ya blame me? You’re so soft back here!
Rascal… You know there’s two holes in there, right?
Oooh, y’know. I thought I felt something different every so often…
You are my first bird. I hope I didn’t hurt you.
No no, it was quite exciting! I didn’t know what to expect, and that’s the whole allure of this thing!
Gah, dear you’re so cute when you’re satisfied, I simply must smooch you~
Baww haha, thanks for this you two…
Think you’re ready to go public?
Haha that’s ok- Oh, I think she wants the gag out.
But I definitely want to do this again…
I haven’t had a go with ya yet!
I’ve got a few toys I think you’d love…
Oooh, I’d love to see that! But gosh I’m beat.
I think I’ll leave you two to it!
Aw, ok hun. Thanks for helping me out!
We’ll catch you up on our shenanigans later!
Thanks for warming her up for me!
Now for the real fun to begin…
